d: Dubai, Dubai Airport Free Zone – Hybrid working

Join our finance team as a Financial Accountant, where you'll play a key role in delivering accurate financial reporting, ensuring compliance with IFRS and statutory requirements, and supporting strategic business decisions. Working closely with the Senior Finance Manager, you’ll contribute to financial controls, audits, tax compliance, budgeting, and the implementation of finance systems, helping drive continuous improvement across a dynamic global business.
q: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline; ACCA, CPA, CA, or CMA preferred.
Strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, month-end close, tax compliance, and Group reporting.
Experience in financial accounting within a multi-entity environment.
Proficiency in ERP systems (Buildsmart preferred) and advanced MS Excel.
Excellent attention to detail, organisational, and analytical skills.
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams.
Proactive, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
r: Maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail when managing general ledger accounts, preparing financial statements, and producing management reporting packs.
Prepare and maintain general ledger records, financial statements, and Group management reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company standards.
Proactively investigate, document, and resolve reconciling items in a timely manner, ensuring all balances are fully supported and unexplained differences are eliminated.
Adhere to the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental responsibility, including actively supporting pollution prevention initiatives.
Deliver work to the highest standards of quality and professionalism, in line with the Company’s Integrated Management System and Group finance policies.
Take ownership of personal development by identifying training needs, discussing them with your line manager, and making full use of available learning and development opportunities.
